<style>
*{

    box-sizing:border-box;

}

body{

/* ================= TOP BAR ================= */

.topbar{
    background:#061b3a;
    color:#fff;
    padding:8px 6%;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:center;
    font-size:14px;
}

.topbar a{
    color:#fff;
    text-decoration:none;
    margin-left:15px;
}

/* ================= HEADER ================= */

header{
    background:#fff;
    padding:14px 6%;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    z-index:1000;
    box-shadow:0 2px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
}

.logo{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:12px;
}

.logo-box{
    width:48px;
    height:48px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#075bea,#00a8ff);
    color:white;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
    border-radius:12px;
    font-size:22px;
    font-weight:bold;
}

.logo h2{
    color:#075bea;
    font-size:22px;
}

.logo small{
    color:#666;
    display:block;
    font-size:11px;
}

nav{
    display:flex;
    gap:25px;
    align-items:center;
}

nav a{
    text-decoration:none;
    color:#172033;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:15px;
}

nav a:hover{
    color:#075bea;
}

.menu-btn{
    display:none;
    font-size:28px;
    cursor:pointer;
}

/* ================= HERO ================= */

.hero{
    min-height:570px;
    background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(3,20,55,.94),rgba(3,45,100,.78)),
    url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1523240795612-9a054b0db644?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1600&q=80");
    background-size:cover;
    background-position:center;
    color:#fff;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    padding:70px 6%;
}

.hero-content{
    max-width:750px;
}

.badge{
    display:inline-block;
    background:#ffcc00;
    color:#111;
    padding:7px 15px;
    border-radius:30px;
    font-weight:bold;
    margin-bottom:18px;
}

.hero h1{
    font-size:52px;
    line-height:1.15;
    margin-bottom:18px;
}

.hero h1 span{
    color:#ffcc00;
}

.hero p{
    font-size:19px;
    color:#e9f1ff;
    margin-bottom:28px;
}

.buttons{
    display:flex;
    gap:15px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
}

.btn{
    padding:13px 23px;
    border-radius:8px;
    text-decoration:none;
    font-weight:bold;
    display:inline-block;
}

.btn-primary{
    background:#ffcc00;
    color:#111;
}

.btn-primary:hover{
    background:#ffd83d;
}

.btn-white{
    background:#fff;
    color:#075bea;
}

/* ================= TRUST ================= */

.trust{
    margin-top:-45px;
    position:relative;
    z-index:5;
    padding:0 6%;
}

.trust-grid{
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:16px;
    box-shadow:0 10px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    overflow:hidden;
}

.trust-box{
    padding:25px;
    text-align:center;
    border-right:1px solid #eee;
}

.trust-box:last-child{
    border-right:none;
}

.trust-box .icon{
    font-size:32px;
}

.trust-box h3{
    color:#075bea;
    margin:7px 0;
}

.trust-box p{
    color:#666;
    font-size:14px;
}

/* ================= SECTION ================= */

section{
    padding:80px 6%;
}

.section-title{
    text-align:center;
    max-width:750px;
    margin:0 auto 45px;
}

.section-title span{
    color:#075bea;
    font-weight:bold;
}

.section-title h2{
    font-size:36px;
    margin:8px 0;
}

.section-title p{
    color:#666;
}

/* ================= SERVICES ================= */

.service-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    gap:20px;
}

.service-card{
    background:#fff;
    padding:28px 22px;
    border-radius:15px;
    box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.07);
    transition:.3s;
    border:1px solid #edf1f6;
}

.service-card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-7px);
    box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
}

.service-icon{
    width:58px;
    height:58px;
    background:#eaf2ff;
    border-radius:14px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:28px;
    margin-bottom:15px;
}

.service-card h3{
    margin-bottom:8px;
    color:#10254b;
}

.service-card p{
    color:#666;
    font-size:14px;
    margin-bottom:15px;
}

.more{
    color:#075bea;
    font-weight:bold;
    text-decoration:none;
}

/* ================= ABOUT ================= */

.about{
    background:#eef5ff;
}

.about-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:50px;
    align-items:center;
}

.about-image{
    min-height:400px;
    border-radius:20px;
    background:
    linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,72,173,.3),rgba(0,0,0,.2)),
    url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1497366754035-f200968a6e72?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80");
    background-size:cover;
    background-position:center;
}

.about-content h2{
    font-size:38px;
    margin-bottom:15px;
}

.about-content p{
    color:#555;
    margin-bottom:18px;
}

.check-list{
    list-style:none;
}

.check-list li{
    margin:10px 0;
    font-weight:600;
}

.check-list li::before{
    content:"✓";
    color:#0a8f35;
    font-weight:bold;
    margin-right:10px;
}

/* ================= PROCESS ================= */

.process-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    gap:20px;
}

.process{
    text-align:center;
    padding:25px;
}

.number{
    width:55px;
    height:55px;
    background:#075bea;
    color:#fff;
    border-radius:50%;
    margin:0 auto 15px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:20px;
    font-weight:bold;
}

.process h3{
    margin-bottom:8px;
}

.process p{
    color:#666;
    font-size:14px;
}

/* ================= EDUCATION ================= */

.education{
    background:#061b3a;
    color:white;
}

.education .section-title p{
    color:#cbd8ec;
}

.course-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    gap:20px;
}

.course{
    background:#102d57;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    padding:25px;
    border-radius:15px;
    transition:.3s;
}

.course:hover{
    transform:translateY(-5px);
    background:#14386b;
}

.course-icon{
    font-size:35px;
    margin-bottom:10px;
}

.course h3{
    margin-bottom:7px;
}

.course p{
    color:#cbd8ec;
    font-size:14px;
}

.course a{
    display:inline-block;
    margin-top:15px;
    color:#ffcc00;
    text-decoration:none;
    font-weight:bold;
}

/* ================= POPULAR SERVICES ================= */

.popular{
    background:#fff;
}

.popular-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:20px;
}

.popular-card{
    border:1px solid #e5eaf2;
    padding:25px;
    border-radius:15px;
    background:#fff;
}

.popular-card h3{
    color:#075bea;
    margin-bottom:10px;
}

.popular-card ul{
    list-style:none;
}

.popular-card li{
    padding:7px 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid #eee;
}

.popular-card li:last-child{
    border-bottom:none;
}

/* ================= ENQUIRY ================= */

.enquiry{
    background:
    linear-gradient(135deg,#075bea,#002b68);
    color:#fff;
}

.enquiry-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:50px;
    align-items:center;
}

.enquiry h2{
    font-size:40px;
    margin-bottom:15px;
}

.enquiry p{
    color:#dce8ff;
}

.form-box{
    background:#fff;
    padding:30px;
    border-radius:18px;
}

.form-box h3{
    color:#172033;
    margin-bottom:20px;
}

.form-group{
    margin-bottom:14px;
}

.form-group input,
.form-group select,
.form-group textarea{
    width:100%;
    padding:13px;
    border:1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius:8px;
    outline:none;
}

.form-group textarea{
    height:100px;
    resize:none;
}

.submit-btn{
    width:100%;
    border:none;
    padding:14px;
    background:#075bea;
    color:#fff;
    border-radius:8px;
    font-weight:bold;
    cursor:pointer;
}

/* ================= CONTACT ================= */

.contact-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:20px;
}

.contact-card{
    background:#fff;
    padding:30px;
    border-radius:15px;
    text-align:center;
    box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
}

.contact-card .icon{
    font-size:35px;
}

.contact-card h3{
    margin:8px 0;
}

.contact-card p{
    color:#666;
}

.contact-card a{
    color:#075bea;
    text-decoration:none;
    font-weight:bold;
}

/* ================= FOOTER ================= */

footer{
    background:#061326;
    color:#fff;
    padding:55px 6% 20px;
}

.footer-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap:35px;
}

footer h3{
    margin-bottom:15px;
}

footer p{
    color:#bdc8d9;
    font-size:14px;
}

footer ul{
    list-style:none;
}

footer li{
    margin:9px 0;
}

footer a{
    color:#bdc8d9;
    text-decoration:none;
}

footer a:hover{
    color:#ffcc00;
}

.copyright{
    border-top:1px solid #24354f;
    margin-top:35px;
    padding-top:18px;
    text-align:center;
    color:#9faabd;
    font-size:13px;
}

/* ================= FLOAT BUTTONS ================= */

.float-call,
.float-whatsapp{
    position:fixed;
    bottom:20px;
    width:58px;
    height:58px;
    border-radius:50%;
    color:#fff;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
    text-decoration:none;
    font-size:25px;
    z-index:999;
    box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}

.float-call{
    right:90px;
    background:#075bea;
}

.float-whatsapp{
    right:20px;
    background:#16b951;
}

/* ================= RESPONSIVE ================= */

@media(max-width:1000px){

    .service-grid,
    .course-grid{
        grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
    }

    .trust-grid{
        grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
    }

    .process-grid{
        grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
    }

    .footer-grid{
        grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    }
}

@media(max-width:768px){

    .topbar{
        display:none;
    }

    nav{
        display:none;
        position:absolute;
        top:75px;
        left:0;
        right:0;
        background:#fff;
        flex-direction:column;
        padding:20px;
        box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.1);
    }

    nav.active{
        display:flex;
    }

    .menu-btn{
        display:block;
    }

    .hero{
        min-height:520px;
        padding:55px 6%;
    }

    .hero h1{
        font-size:38px;
    }

    .hero p{
        font-size:16px;
    }

    .about-grid,
    .enquiry-grid{
        grid-template-columns:1fr;
    }

    .popular-grid,
    .contact-grid{
        grid-template-columns:1fr;
    }

    .section-title h2{
        font-size:30px;
    }
}

@media(max-width:550px){

    .service-grid,
    .course-grid,
    .trust-grid,
    .process-grid{
        grid-template-columns:1fr;
    }

    .footer-grid{
        grid-template-columns:1fr;
    }

    section{
        padding:60px 5%;
    }

    .hero h1{
        font-size:32px;
    }

    .float-call{
        right:85px;
    }
}

/* ================= ABHI COMPUTERS GALLERY ================= */
.gallery-section{
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eef5ff 0%,#ffffff 100%);
}
.gallery-grid{
    max-width:1200px;
    margin:0 auto;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
    gap:24px;
}
.gallery-card{
    position:relative;
    height:390px;
    overflow:hidden;
    border-radius:20px;
    background:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
    border:1px solid #e3e8f2;
    cursor:pointer;
    outline:none;
}
.gallery-card img{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    display:block;
    object-fit:cover;
    transition:transform .55s ease;
}
.gallery-card:hover img,
.gallery-card:focus img{
    transform:scale(1.06);
}
.gallery-overlay{
    position:absolute;
    left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
    padding:28px 22px 20px;
    color:#fff;
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-end;
    justify-content:space-between;
    background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.9));
}
.gallery-overlay h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:21px;}
.gallery-overlay p{margin:0;color:#eee;font-size:14px;}
.gallery-zoom{
    width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;
    display:grid;place-items:center;
    background:#ffcc00;color:#111;
    font-size:22px;font-weight:bold;
    flex:none;
}
.gallery-lightbox{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    z-index:99999;
    display:none;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:20px;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.94);
}
.gallery-lightbox.active{display:flex;}
.gallery-lightbox img{
    max-width:94vw;
    max-height:90vh;
    object-fit:contain;
    border-radius:10px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
}
.gallery-close,.gallery-prev,.gallery-next{
    position:absolute;
    border:0;
    width:48px;height:48px;
    border-radius:50%;
    cursor:pointer;
    color:#fff;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
    font-size:30px;
    z-index:2;
}
.gallery-close{right:22px;top:18px;}
.gallery-prev{left:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);}
.gallery-next{right:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);}
.gallery-counter{
    position:absolute;
    bottom:18px;left:50%;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
    color:#fff;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);
    padding:5px 13px;
    border-radius:20px;
}
@media(max-width:768px){
    .gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .gallery-card{height:320px;}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
    .gallery-card{height:270px;}
    .gallery-overlay{padding:22px 16px 16px;}
    .gallery-overlay h3{font-size:18px;}
}

</style>

function renderOnlineServices(){
  const q=(document.getElementById('serviceSearch').value||'').toLowerCase().trim();
  const cat=document.getElementById('serviceCategory').value;
  let shown=0;
  document.querySelectorAll('.online-card').forEach(card=>{
    const okCat=!cat || card.dataset.cat===cat;
    const okQ=!q || card.dataset.search.includes(q);
    const show=okCat && okQ;
    card.style.display=show?'flex':'none';
    if(show) shown++;
  });
  document.getElementById('serviceCount').textContent=shown+' सेवाएं दिखाई जा रही हैं';
}
function openService(i){
  const s=ABHI_SERVICES[i];
  document.getElementById('modalContent').innerHTML=`
    <span class="modal-tag">${esc(s.cat)}</span>
    <h2>${esc(s.name)}</h2>
    <div class="modal-section"><h4>📌 सेवा की जानकारी</h4><p>${esc(s.desc)}</p></div>
    <div class="modal-section"><h4>📄 सामान्यतः आवश्यक Documents</h4><ul><li>${esc(s.docs)}</li></ul></div>
    <div class="modal-section"><h4>📝 आवेदन / काम करने की प्रक्रिया</h4><p>${esc(s.steps)}</p></div>
    <a class="modal-main-link" href="${s.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🚀 इस काम के लिए Online Service खोलें ↗</a>`;
  document.getElementById('serviceModal').classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
}
function closeService(){
  document.getElementById('serviceModal').classList.remove('active');
  document.body.style.overflow='';
}
function esc(v){return String(v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeService();});
</script>

<script>
const abhiGalleryImages = [
    "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
];

let abhiGalleryIndex = 0;

function openGallery(index){
    abhiGalleryIndex = index;
    document.getElementById("galleryFullImage").src = abhiGalleryImages[abhiGalleryIndex];
    document.getElementById("galleryCounter").textContent =
        (abhiGalleryIndex + 1) + " / " + abhiGalleryImages.length;
    document.getElementById("galleryLightbox").classList.add("active");
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
}

function closeGallery(){
    document.getElementById("galleryLightbox").classList.remove("active");
    document.body.style.overflow = "";
}

function closeGalleryOnBackdrop(event){
    if(event.target.id === "galleryLightbox") closeGallery();
}

function galleryNext(event){
    if(event) event.stopPropagation();
    abhiGalleryIndex = (abhiGalleryIndex + 1) % abhiGalleryImages.length;
    document.getElementById("galleryFullImage").src = abhiGalleryImages[abhiGalleryIndex];
    document.getElementById("galleryCounter").textContent =
        (abhiGalleryIndex + 1) + " / " + abhiGalleryImages.length;
}

function galleryPrev(event){
    if(event) event.stopPropagation();
    abhiGalleryIndex = (abhiGalleryIndex - 1 + abhiGalleryImages.length) % abhiGalleryImages.length;
    document.getElementById("galleryFullImage").src = abhiGalleryImages[abhiGalleryIndex];
    document.getElementById("galleryCounter").textContent =
        (abhiGalleryIndex + 1) + " / " + abhiGalleryImages.length;
}

document.addEventListener("keydown", function(event){
    const box = document.getElementById("galleryLightbox");
    if(!box.classList.contains("active")) return;
    if(event.key === "Escape") closeGallery();
    if(event.key === "ArrowRight") galleryNext(event);
    if(event.key === "ArrowLeft") galleryPrev(event);
});
</script>

</body>
</html>
